review:
A 25-line Egyptian game with two features. Enough money symbols start a Respin Round where they lock in place, with jackpots up to 1,000x.

In free spins, random special symbols expand across the reels, book-style. A modest 2,500x cap suggests a steadier ride than many modern games. 96.5% RTP. Classic Egypt with a cash-collect feature on top.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
